text: Independent actuarial analysis must estimate workers compensation loss reserves, including incurred but not reported losses, on discounted and undiscounted bases

citations.text: Workers’ Compensation Actuarial Services will consist of an independent actuarial analysis of the loss reserve (incurred but not reported) related to the Workers’ Compensation Coverage.
The study must provide an estimate of the total reserves as of the end of the year on both a discounted and undiscounted basis.

text: Additional work includes agency loss estimates, two-year payment forecasts, participant withdrawal liabilities, contingencies, reserve allocations, and known-claim and IBNR provisions

citations.text: The Actuary must be able to provide the following additional services to the fund:
•Estimate of the expected losses for the upcoming calendar year by agency.
•Estimate of the future loss payments by calendar year for the next two (2) years.
•Calculation of discounted and non-discounted unpaid liabilities at year’s end.
•Calculation for each individual participant to cover open liabilities if they withdraw from the plan.
•Anticipated and unanticipated contingencies.
•Allocation of reserves and/or funding to individual plan participants.
•Estimate of necessary reserves to include a provision for both known claims and claims that have been incurred but not reported (IBNR).

text: If disclosure is required or authorized, disclose only portions the County considers legally required and seek written assurance of confidential treatment where permitted by law

citations.text: In the event that such protective order or other remedy is not obtained, or the County waives compliance with this Article 15, or determines that such disclosure is legally required, the Firm shall disclose only such portions of Confidential Information that, in the opinion of the County, the Firm is legally required to disclose, and the Firm shall use its best efforts to obtain from the party to whom Confidential Information is disclosed, written assurance that confidential treatment will be given to any such Confidential Information disclosed, to the extent permitted by law.

text: If the agreement is for covered public work, pay workers at least the prevailing wage and supplements

text: If claims-made insurance ends, purchase unlimited extended reporting coverage for claims arising from the services

text: Immediately notify the County through the Department Head, County Attorney’s Office, and Risk Management of incidents that might give rise to claims

text: Investigate, handle, respond to, and defend covered claims at the Firm’s sole expense, and bear related costs even if claims are groundless, false, or fraudulent
